name: DAYs
source:
In a zombie apocalypse world main character barricades in the apartment with a lot of cereal and keeps watching out for help through the telescope. One day he sees a girl attacked by zombies, and he decides to go out for the first time to rescue her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在丧尸末日中，主人公囤积了大量谷物食品，将自己封闭在公寓里，不断用望远镜眺望，等待救援。某天，他看见一名女孩遭到丧尸袭击，决定第一次走出公寓，去救她。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
